review_scope: Assistant technical source review; not independent human/legal approval.
change_classes: full rebuild from the official source text layer with relay.py (paragraphs, page furniture, scramble-free order)
source_pdf_note: mevzuat.gov.tr File/GeneratePdf output is regenerated per request (not byte-reproducible)

pre_review_gate.note: Pre-review gate on the unreviewed relay draft (token multiset, sections, content-stream order, punctuation); 'review'/'fail' sent the draft to the review recorded in gate_resolution before anything was applied.

gate_resolution: 17 paragraph-break difference(s) from the stored text; rebuilt breaks follow the PDF layout (indentation and vertical spacing)
layout_not_carried: bold, italic and underline emphasis; font sizes; page breaks
justified-line double spaces collapse to single spaces; physical line breaks inside a paragraph are kept
bare page numbers and the BDDK letterhead footer (address/phone/web lines) are page furniture and are dropped
list bullets come from the PDF text layer (private-use bullet glyphs mapped to • ▪ ➢ ✓ → —)
multi-line capitalised titles are one paragraph; paragraph breaks follow PDF indentation, short closing lines and vertical spacing
table cells merged across rows or columns repeat their label in each cell; line breaks inside a cell are
